coverageContext: European-discovery lupus research score evaluated for disease onset and outcomes. GA calculates only the additive genetic component; it cannot predict individual damage, survival or treatment response.
Research score evaluated in two European-ancestry population studies. Genetic susceptibility does not diagnose melanoma or replace assessment of skin changes, sun exposure and family history.
Research thyroid cancer susceptibility model with European-ancestry discovery and evaluation. This raw genetic score does not establish an individual cancer probability or screening recommendation.

Published additive venous thromboembolism research score. It does not identify an acute clot, provide absolute risk, or guide anticoagulant use; study-specific covariate models are not reproduced by GA.
Thirteen-variant gout research score. It is not a serum urate measurement, a diagnostic test, or a treatment recommendation. Missing comparison alleles are not invented.
Separate 248-variant gout research model. Scores from different models are not averaged; a higher variant count does not establish superior prediction or clinical utility.

Research score evaluated for incident venous thromboembolism after COVID-19 vaccination in middle-aged and older adults. It does not establish vaccine causation or support personal vaccination or anticoagulation decisions.
Research score studied alongside lifestyle factors for thyroid cancer. GA does not reproduce the combined clinical or lifestyle model and does not estimate absolute cancer risk.
PRS-CS research model from a small Taiwanese study, with East Asian discovery and evaluation. Limited sample size and ancestry transferability restrict interpretation; it is not a diagnostic test.
